interruptedModules.reason: After island-500-run-1 was persisted at 16:53:38.378Z, the collector remained idle for over 10 minutes in browser teardown. The dedicated Chrome root had already exited; no next round started. A 1-second Node sample at 17:00:22Z showed idle event-loop and worker threads.
interruptedModules.action: Stop only this owned collector, retain original bytes and diagnostic, fix collector teardown and run a new complete matrix. No measurements are pooled or overwritten.
interruptedModules.note: Seven completed rounds from a collector teardown interruption. Incomplete matrix; excluded from every final comparison and statistic. Original manifest was not rewritten.

teardownCheck.note: Two cases after collector-only teardown fix. Does not replace or pool into the final formal matrix.
